explication: UX/UI Agent Skills is an instruction-and-knowledge kit for Claude-based design work, not an application runtime. A designer or engineer gives a brief to an AI agent, which combines skills, rules, tokens, component guidance, accessibility standards, framework adapters, and design references to produce UI code. The CLI installs or scaffolds that kit. Generated artifacts can then be checked by objective gates and evaluation runners. The graph reflects sampled source plus README capabilities; several skill internals were not inspected.
